reasoning: All eight delivered exact dependencies passed the recorded Qt/native preservation gates with both native guards bypassed on both compared runtimes. They compare stock against corrected Qt, not guard-on against guard-off on corrected Qt.
The raw33/66 fixture draws QPainter paths/rectangles; it does not invoke QGCustomPath or QGCustomRect.

QGCustomPath only skips a public-stroker-empty outline for no-fill, nonopaque solid-pattern dashed, noncosmetic width>=0.0001, transparent background, affine supported nonarchival PDF. Excluded modes delegate without changing path/pen/brush.
QGCustomRect maintains a global no-draw null-rectangle contract, including non-PDF painting. A visible nonnull frame or horizontal/vertical/negative rectangle delegates.

Stock and corrected binaries share reported6.11.1/6.11.2, so a numeric Qt version cannot authenticate this correction. Exact package/SDK build, source and loaded-library identity is necessary; arbitrary system Qt remains possible outside opt-in qualified selection.
